chunks: They said, 'O our father, we went racing and left Joseph with our belongings, so a wolf devoured him. And you will not believe us even if we are truthful.'
ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brothers tell their father about his disappearance?
ai.summary: In this verse, the brothers' claim that a wolf devoured Joseph while they were racing serves as a pivotal moment in the narrative of Surah Yusuf, illustrating the gradual erosion of their father Jacob's trust. Shia scholars often highlight the phrase 'even if we were truthful' as a rhetorical device emphasizing Jacob's intuitive knowledge (ilm al-yaqin) of Joseph's innocence, rooted in his prophetic insight and deep paternal love. This incident underscores the theme of divine decree (maktub) amidst human deception, setting the stage for Joseph's eventual rise to power.
